plan: Represent the adaptation as a pure transformation: never touch input dicts; build the adapted recipe from fresh objects and pass authored_text through verbatim so print_original stays byte-exact.
Scale every quantity (main, component, and catalog-added ingredients) by the Fraction ratio target_yield / original yield before substitution logic runs.

Resolve each excluded ingredient recursively through the catalog: pick the entry with minimal (priority, catalog index), apply quantity_factor/unit/preparation overrides, record wording pairs, equipment deltas, yield factors, and choice IDs, then re-resolve the replacement and any additional ingredients so chains and reintroduced exclusions are handled by the same code path.
Carry a frozenset chain of visited names through the recursion; a replacement that is both excluded and already in the chain yields the 'substitution cycle involving NAME' reason.

Accumulate everything in a context record (choices, warnings, reasons-set, wording pairs, equipment add/remove, yield factors); process all ingredients and all equipment before judging impossibility so every independent reason is collected, then dedupe and sort.

Adapt optional components in a sandboxed child context: merge it on success, or drop the component with an 'omitted optional component NAME' warning on failure; required components merge their reasons and force impossibility.

After all substitutions succeed, apply the recorded wording pairs as ordered str.replace passes over instruction strings, compute equipment as (original - removals) | additions sorted and checked against availability, and set the final yield to target times any yield factors (warning if changed).

Finish with a __main__ self-test covering the seven acceptance scenarios: 3→5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment substitution, reintroduced exclusion, cycle detection, multiple simultaneous reasons, byte-exact original print with no input mutation, and priority/order-deterministic choice.
mechanisms: Fraction-ratio yield scaling applied uniformly to all quantities
Deterministic catalog selection by min(priority, catalog index)
Recursive exclusion resolution with visited-name chain for cycle detection
Single accumulator context for choices, warnings, wording pairs, equipment deltas, and yield factors
Exhaustive independent reason gathering with set-dedupe and sorted emission
Ordered global wording-rewrite pass over instruction strings
Set-algebra equipment adjustment followed by availability check and sorted output
Sandboxed child context for optional components: merge on success, drop with warning on failure
Pure construction of the output recipe with authored_text passed through verbatim
